title: 第3章 何为公道？
slug: 武破九荒全本免费-武破九荒最新章节列表
content_zh:
“萧霸！”看着来人，萧叶面色阴沉下来。
萧霸是萧腾的父亲，也是如今萧家村猎兽队的队长，把握村内实权的人物，拥有后天七重天的实力。
说起来，萧霸与萧洪之间还有些恩怨，因为两者年轻的时候，一直将对方视为对手，若不是萧阳经脉俱碎，他还无法坐上猎兽队队长的位子。
“你们父子俩装清高，对丹药不屑一顾。但那三颗炼体丹，是属于村子的，你们无权做主。”萧霸冷冷道。
他早就来到了这里，但是一直没有出声。
萧腾跟在萧霸身后，得意一笑。
现在村长外出闭关，村内最有话语权的就是他爹了，所以那三颗炼体丹，他志在必得。
屋内村民互相对视，最后尽皆点了点头。萧阳父子虽然拒绝了修脉丹，但还有三颗炼体丹在萧大山手中呢。
三颗炼体丹，足够让一位炼体境的小辈，实力提升好几倍。
但，该怎么分配？
萧霸背负双手，说道：“村长闭关，村内大小事务由我做主。这三颗炼体丹，应该给村内最有资质的小辈服用！”
“我儿萧腾，年仅十六岁，就有着炼体八重天的实力，我建议，这三颗炼体丹就给他了。”
萧霸直接忽略了萧叶的存在，凌厉的目光扫视全场，但凡被萧霸目光扫中的村民，皆是心头一颤，最后低下了头。
萧霸人如其名，行事很是霸道，因为畏惧他地位和实力，很多村民敢怒不敢言。
萧叶闻言，心中怒火燃烧，萧霸这是想趁着村长不在，实行独裁权利，独吞炼体丹啊。
最有资质？真是可笑！
萧腾如果不是得到众多药材辅助炼体，岂能有如今的实力？在萧叶眼中，萧腾就是个二世祖而已。
要是萧霸真的为了村子着想，心平气和的商量炼体丹的归属，萧叶肯定会让出这三颗炼体丹，因为柳依依留下的东西，他绝对不会去碰。
“我同意让萧腾服用炼体丹！”
“我也同意！”

半晌，有一位村民第一个开口，紧接着引起了众人的附和。
萧叶一眼扫去，发现最为积极的，是与萧霸走得近的村民，心头怒意更甚。
“你们眼瞎了吗？萧腾能和萧叶比？难道你们看不出来，到底谁才是萧家村的第一天才吗！”萧大山跳了出来，满脸怒意，破口大骂。
“大山，你别激动。萧叶和萧腾，是村内最出色的两个小辈，他们的实力不分上下，我们选择萧腾，并没有什么过错吧？”一位村民站出来道。
“不分上下？”萧大山一愣，这时他才想起来，众人还不知道萧叶突破到炼体九重。
在不知道情况下，村民如此选择，倒也没错。毕竟真灵大陆，是拿实力说话的。而且，谁肯为了一个已成废人的萧阳，得罪萧霸？
“既然诸位都同意我的建议，那请无关人等离开吧！”萧霸嘴角浮现一丝讥讽，目光看向萧阳。
他的意思很明显，萧阳，是无关人等。
众人眼中有怜悯，有同情，也有惋惜，当初萧家村除却村长外的最强者，却落到如此田地。
“叶儿，走吧，回家。”萧阳一直沉默不语，眼神中的怒意一闪而逝，继而身形落寞的转身，向着屋外行去。
自从他经脉俱碎后，他已经成为萧家村可有可无的人物，而今天，他再次体会到了这种感觉。
望着萧阳落寞的身影，萧叶心脏蓦然揪紧了起来。
“爹，我不走！”萧叶倔强道，接着他缓步走到场中，冰冷的目光看向萧霸，“做主，你还真是做个好主啊！”
此刻，他压抑在心底的情绪彻底爆发出来，整个人就像是一头凶兽觉醒过来。
“放肆！村内长辈商议的结果，岂能容得你一个小辈来质疑？”萧霸还没开口，站在他身旁的村民却抢先一步大声道。
“长辈商议的结果？”
面对欺压，萧叶身如标枪，站得笔直，苍凉大笑：“那这个结果还真是公道啊！”
萧叶的笑声，在屋内回荡，让众多村民心中羞愧，不敢与其对视。
凝望着默然的众人，萧叶眼中寒芒一闪，道：“既然这是你们认为的公道，那我便亲手推翻它！”
说完，萧叶豁然转身，指着萧腾道：“萧腾，今日我萧叶向你挑战！”

萧叶挑战萧腾？
这突然的转变，让众人稍微有些反应不过来。

content_en:
"Xiao Ba!" Looking at the person coming, Xiao Ye's face darkened.
Xiao Ba is Xiao Teng's father and is currently the captain of the Xiaojiacun Beast Hunting Team. He is a man who holds the real power in the village and possesses the seventh level of acquired strength.
Speaking of which, there is still some grudge between Xiao Ba and Xiao Hong, because when they were young, they always regarded each other as their rivals. If Xiao Yang's meridians had not been broken, he would not have been able to sit on the position of captain of the beast hunting team.
"You two, father and son, pretend to be noble and disdainful of pills. But those three body refining pills belong to the village, and you have no right to make the decision." Xiao Ba said coldly.
He had been here a long time ago, but he had never made a sound.
Xiao Teng followed Xiao Ba and smiled proudly.
Now that the village chief is out for retreat, the person with the most say in the village is his father, so he is determined to get the three body refining pills.
The villagers in the room looked at each other, and finally nodded. Although Xiao Yang and his son rejected the Pulse Cultivation Pill, there are still three Body Refining Pills in Xiao Dashan's hands.
Three body refining pills are enough to increase the strength of a junior in the body refining realm several times.
But how to distribute it?
Xiao Ba put his hands behind his back and said: "The village chief is in seclusion, and I am in charge of all matters in the village. These three body refining pills should be given to the most qualified juniors in the village!"
"My son Xiao Teng is only sixteen years old and has the strength of the eighth level of body refining. I suggest that these three body refining pills be given to him."
Xiao Ba directly ignored Xiao Ye's existence and scanned the whole place with his sharp eyes. All the villagers caught by Xiao Ba's gaze trembled in their hearts and finally lowered their heads.
Xiao Ba lived up to his name and acted very domineeringly. Many villagers dared not speak out because they were afraid of his status and strength.
When Xiao Ye heard this, his heart burned with anger. Xiao Ba wanted to take advantage of the village chief's absence to exercise dictatorial power and monopolize the body refining pill.
Most qualified? How ridiculous!
How could Xiao Teng be as strong as he is now if he hadn't received numerous medicinal materials to help him refine his body? In Xiao Ye's eyes, Xiao Teng is just a second-generation ancestor.
If Xiao Ba really thinks about the village and calmly discusses the ownership of the body refining pills, Xiao Ye will definitely give up these three body refining pills, because he will never touch the things Liu Yiyi left behind.
"I agree to let Xiao Teng take the Body Refining Pill!"
"I agree too!"
After a while, a villager was the first to speak, which immediately attracted everyone's agreement.
Xiao Ye glanced around and found that the most positive people were the villagers who were close to Xiao Ba, and he felt even more angry.
"Are you blind? Can Xiao Teng compete with Xiao Ye? Can't you see who is the number one genius in Xiaojia Village!" Xiao Dashan jumped out, his face full of anger, and he cursed loudly.
"Da Shan, don't get excited. Xiao Ye and Xiao Teng are the two most outstanding juniors in the village. Their strength is equally matched. There is nothing wrong with us choosing Xiao Teng, right?" A villager stood up and said.
"No distinction between top and bottom?" Xiao Dashan was stunned. Only then did he remember that everyone didn't know that Xiao Ye had broken through to the ninth level of body refining.
It is not wrong for the villagers to make this choice without knowing the situation. After all, Zhenling Continent is based on strength. Moreover, who is willing to offend Xiao Ba for a crippled Henry Zhang?
"Since everyone agrees with my suggestion, please leave the irrelevant ones!" A trace of sarcasm appeared on the corner of Xiao Ba's mouth and he looked at Henry Zhang.
His meaning is obvious, Henry Zhang, it has nothing to do with others.
There was pity, sympathy, and regret in everyone's eyes. The strongest person in Xiaojia Village except the village chief ended up in this situation.
"Ye'er, let's go home." Henry Zhang remained silent, the anger in his eyes flashed away, and then he turned around lonely and walked out of the house.
Since his meridians were broken, he has become a dispensable figure in Xiaojia Village, and today, he felt this feeling again.
Looking at Xiao Yang's lonely figure, Xiao Ye's heart suddenly tightened.
"Dad, I won't leave!" Xiao Ye said stubbornly, then he walked slowly to the field and looked at Xiao Ba with cold eyes, "Be the master, you are really a good master!"
At this moment, the emotions he had suppressed in his heart completely burst out, and his whole person was like a ferocious beast awakening.
"Insolent! How can you, a junior like you, be allowed to question the results of the deliberations of the elders in the village?" Before Xiao Ba could speak, the villagers standing next to him shouted loudly.
"The result of the elders' discussion?"
Facing the oppression, Xiao Ye stood up straight like a javelin and laughed desolately: "Then this result is really fair!"
Xiao Ye's laughter echoed in the house, making many villagers feel ashamed and did not dare to look at him.
Staring at the silent crowd, Xiao Ye's eyes flashed coldly and said: "Since this is what you think is fair, then I will overturn it with my own hands!"
After saying that, Xiao Ye suddenly turned around, pointed at Xiao Teng and said: "Xiao Teng, I, Xiao Ye, challenge you today!"
Xiao Ye challenges Xiao Teng?
This sudden change made everyone a little unable to react.
